name: The Elemental Equation
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Greetings, adventurer! Are you interested in some work? I pay those under my employ with insignias. These insignias can be used at the Quartermaster to purchase items of power.

All I need you to do is bring me as many core of elements as you can carry. The more the better!

You'll find them on elementals of varying shapes and sizes that exist across our world.
narrative.objectives: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Core of Elements.
narrative.offerRewardText: A job well done, adventurer! As promised, the INsignia is yours. Just remember, there's more WHERE that came from...
narrative.requestItemsText: I can only steer you in the right direction, adventurer.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 60, 6,600 XP in all.
